field_notes.Due Date: Final submission deadline, including time and source time zone; do not confuse with questions deadlines. Preserve literal zone abbreviations; disclose conflicting sources instead of silently correcting them.
field_notes.Pre Bid Meeting: Date, time, location/online method and mandatory status when explicit. Do not assume mandatory or optional if unstated.
field_notes.Bid Bond Requirement: Bid bond, not insurance limits, performance bond, or funding from municipal bonds. Use Not required only when explicitly stated.
field_notes.Model_no: Requested commercial product model designations, including each product category when stated. A system integration/configuration reference (SI or quote ID) alone is not the product model; put such references in Part_no instead.
field_notes.Part_no: Manufacturer SKU/part numbers with what they identify. Include primary product/base SKU and configured-system reference when supplied; distinguish these from commercial model names and CPU model numbers.
field_notes.Contract or Cooperative to use: Referenced master/state/cooperative contract name and identifier, including contract eligibility restrictions. A master contract under which this purchase is competed belongs here even if the word cooperative is absent.
field_notes.MFG for Registration: Name the manufacturer(s) the bidder must be registered or authorized with. An OEM warranty obligation is not bidder registration. Generic certifications without a named manufacturer do not identify one; use null when no manufacturer registration/authorization requirement is stated.
field_notes.contact_info: Procurement/solicitation contact name, email and phone when stated. A delivery coordination department or technical support team is not a replacement procurement contact.
field_notes.company_name: Issuing organization, not the supplier or manufacturer.
field_notes.Product: Products and quantities; distinguish estimated volume from guaranteed orders.
field_notes.Delivery Date: Delivery deadline/window, not a planned quote request or anticipated award date.
field_notes.Any Additional Documentation Required: Required submission and post-award forms; label timing and conditions. Preserve if applicable clauses; do not turn every listed form or attachment into an unconditional obligation.

The issuing organization is the State of Maryland Treasurer's Office, and the agency contact is Tamaira Hawkins at thawkins@treasurer.state.md.us with phone number 410-260-7533. Responses are to be submitted through the State's eMaryland Marketplace Advantage system, and bids are not accepted by email, fax, U.S. Mail, or hand delivery. The due date is 06/10/2024 at 2:00 PM EDT, and the delivery date is within 45 days of award. The issuing organization is the State of Maryland Treasurer's Office, and the agency contact is Tamaira Hawkins at thawkins@treasurer.state.md.us with phone number 410-260-7533. Responses are to be submitted through the State's eMaryland Marketplace Advantage system, and bids are not accepted by email, fax, U.S. Mail, or hand delivery. The due date is 06/10/2024 at 2:00 PM EDT, and the delivery date is within 45 days of award. The product includes laptops and a Dell Thunderbolt 4 Dock – WD22TB4, with Dell Latitude 5550 listed as the model number and CC7802, WD22TB4, and 210-BLYZ shown as part references. The specification notes that the laptops must be Microsoft Copilot ready, and the warranty requirement is a 3-year Dell Limited Hardware Warranty with a warranty certificate or affidavit to be presented upon award.
